title: Lovely Weather, Isn't It?

pre.zh: 这段对话是怎么结束的？
options: They decide to go to a pub.
Rachel starts talking about the weather.
Chen talks about his next project.

intro: 第 3 单元的最后一课：小陈又来到伦敦，和 Rachel 当面喝咖啡，回顾这一年——那封客气过头的邮件、没人看的周五报告、电梯里的 CEO、发版和那场演讲，还有 Rachel 家的鼓声。读的时候留意句末的小尾巴（反意疑问句），看它怎么跟前半句的时态、助动词对上；这个单元学过的从句和说法也都会再出现。

sentences.en: Chen! Finally, in person!
sentences.zh: 小陈！终于见到真人了！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: It's so nice to have a chat, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 能当面聊聊真好，是吧？

sentences.en: It is — although I've never seen so much rain!
sentences.zh: 是啊——不过我从没见过这么多雨！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I hope it stops soon.
sentences.zh: 希望雨快点停。

sentences.en: I'm afraid it won't.
sentences.zh: 恐怕停不了。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I'll lend you an umbrella before you go.
sentences.zh: 你走之前我借你把伞。

sentences.en: And you're early!
sentences.zh: 而且你还来早了！

sentences.en: I left early so that I'd have time to get lost.
sentences.zh: 我提早出的门，专门留出迷路的时间。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I promised you a proper coffee, and I've kept my promise, haven't I?
sentences.zh: 我答应过请你喝杯像样的咖啡，说到做到了吧？
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: Thanks — but let's split the bill.
sentences.zh: 谢谢——不过咱们 AA 吧。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Don't be silly, it's my treat.
sentences.zh: 别傻了，我请客。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: Let's catch up properly.
sentences.zh: 咱们好好聊聊近况。

sentences.en: We've really got to know each other this year, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 这一年咱们真是熟了不少，对吧？

sentences.en: We have.
sentences.zh: 是啊。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I used to be so nervous on calls that I hardly said a word.
sentences.zh: 以前开视频会，我紧张得几乎一句话都不敢说。

sentences.en: Arjun told me he'd put your first email on his wall.
sentences.zh: Arjun 跟我说，他把你的第一封邮件贴墙上了。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: You've made a lot of progress.
sentences.zh: 你进步很大。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: All in all, it's been a good year.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这一年挺好的。

sentences.en: The app went live on time, and the new project's on track, isn't it?
sentences.zh: App 按时上线了，新项目也在按计划推进，对吧？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 是啊。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: But we've had a few disasters, haven't we?
sentences.zh: 不过也出过几次大乱子，是吧？

sentences.en: Like the Friday report that nobody read.
sentences.zh: 比如那份没人看的周五报告。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You took responsibility for that, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 那次是你把责任揽下来的，对吧？

sentences.en: Someone had to!
sentences.zh: 总得有人担着嘛！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: Look on the bright side: we don't write it any more.
sentences.zh: 往好处想：咱们再也不用写它了。

sentences.en: The CEO still talks about your presentation!
sentences.zh: CEO 到现在还在夸你那场报告！

sentences.en: He must remember me from the lift!
sentences.zh: 他肯定是电梯那次记住我的！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Do you know if he's in today?
sentences.zh: 你知道他今天在不在吗？

sentences.en: No, but his daughter goes to drum lessons with my son.
sentences.zh: 不在，不过他女儿跟我儿子一起上打鼓课。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: It's a small world, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 世界真小，是吧？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Tiny!
sentences.zh: 小着呢！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: My son practises every day — it sounds like a building site at home.
sentences.zh: 我儿子天天练，家里听着跟工地似的。

sentences.en: I'm always on mute now.
sentences.zh: 我现在开会一直开着静音。

sentences.en: Anyway, keep up the good work, Chen.
sentences.zh: 好了，继续加油，小陈。

sentences.en: You've learned a lot this year, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 你这一年学到了不少，对吧？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 是啊。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I've learned that British people talk about the weather when they don't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 我学到了：英国人不知道说什么的时候，就聊天气。

sentences.en: We don't, do we?
sentences.zh: 我们才不这样呢，是吧？
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: ...Lovely weather today, isn't it?
sentences.zh: ……今天天气真不错，是吧？

cards.note: if you do something in person, you go somewhere or meet someone yourself, not by phone or online
cards.tip: 反义是 online、on a call；face to face 意思接近。
cards.example: It's much easier to solve this kind of problem in person.

cards.note: to talk with someone in a friendly, informal way
cards.tip: 比 talk 随意；chat 也能当动词：We chatted for an hour。英式口语常说 have a quick chat。
cards.example: Have you got five minutes? I'd like to have a chat about the new project.

cards.zh: 恐怕；（客气地说出坏消息）
cards.note: used to politely say something that the other person may not want to hear
to become unable to find your way
英式口语很常用：a proper breakfast（一顿像样的早餐）；副词 properly 是「好好地」：let's catch up properly。
to do what you said you would do
to share the cost of a meal or service between several people
对方客气时回一句 Don't be silly，意思是「别客气了」，语气亲切，不是骂人。
It's my treat. / My treat. 都是「我请」；动词 treat sb to sth 是「请某人吃…」。
to talk to someone you have not seen for a while and hear their news
cards.tip: 跟谁叙旧用 with：catch up with sb；另一个常见意思是「补上落下的」：I need to catch up on my emails。
cards.example: Let's grab a coffee next week and catch up.

cards.note: to spend time with someone so that you learn more about them
cards.tip: 英式英语的完成时是 have got to know，美式常用 have gotten to know。
cards.example: The best way to get to know a city is on foot.

cards.note: hardly 本身就是否定，后面不再加 not；它也不是 hard 的副词，「努力地」还是 hard。
to improve, or to move forward towards a goal
cards.tip: progress 不可数：make a lot of progress，不说 make progresses；动词用 make，不用 do 或 get。
cards.example: We're making good progress on the new design.

cards.note: used to give a general opinion after thinking about every part of something
cards.tip: 多放在句首、后面加逗号，用来做总结；比生硬的 in a word 自然得多。
cards.example: There were a few problems, but all in all the launch went well.

cards.note: if a product, website or system goes live, people can start using it
at the right time, not late
making good progress and likely to finish on time
cards.tip: on track for + 目标或时间；偏离计划是 off track。
cards.example: The project is still on track for March.

cards.note: 口语里常夸张地用来说搞砸了的事：The meeting was a disaster.
to accept that something is your job or your fault

cards.zh: 往好处想；看到好的一面
cards.note: to find something good in a bad situation
cards.tip: 常跟在坏消息后面，冒号或破折号后接「好的一面」：Look on the bright side: …
cards.example: The flight was cancelled, but look on the bright side — we get an extra day here.

cards.note: used when you are surprised to meet someone you know, or to find a connection with someone, in an unexpected place
英式拼写：动词是 practise，名词是 practice；美式两者都写 practice。
if you are on mute in a call, other people cannot hear you
used to tell someone to continue doing something well
cards.tip: 多是上级、老师对人说的鼓励话，常跟在表扬后面；the good work 是固定说法。
cards.example: Great demo today, everyone — keep up the good work!
